reason: I already have free budget apps that do the basic tracking, and I don't want to hand a new app my bank slips or my card statement, even if it's only the text. The features that matter most to me are the ones that need the most trust, and I don't know this company.
objection: Who actually has access to my financial data, and what does 'stored encrypted' mean in practice? I'd want to know who runs this and what happens to my data if the company shuts down.
would_change_my_mind: A clear, independently checked privacy policy with a way to delete all my data and no need for my statements, plus a free version that works well enough that I could see the value before paying anything.
